title: Known by God
story:
A man once worked as a security guard in a large estate.

Every day, he stood at the gate.

People came and went.

But the owner of the estate always knew him personally.

One day, the guard asked,

“There are so many people here. How do you remember me?”

The owner smiled and said,

“I don’t just see the crowd.”

“I know each person who belongs to me.”

The guard felt valued and secure.

In life, we may feel unnoticed.

Like just another face in a crowd.

Forgotten.

Overlooked.

But God is different.

He watches over the lives of those who belong to Him.

He knows their days.

He cares for their future.

And their inheritance is secure in Him forever.
life_lesson:
You are seen, known, and cared for by God.

Your future is secure in His hands.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for watching over my life.

Thank You that I am not forgotten by You.

Help me to trust You with my future.

Give me peace in knowing I belong to You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you ever feel unnoticed or forgotten in life?

How does it change you to know God personally watches over you?

What worries about your future can you give to Him today?
verse:
The Lord knows the days of the blameless,
and their inheritance will endure forever.
